name: fe-kensington-close-golden
js: (async () => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6547, -79.4006); let best = null, bd = Infinity; for (const d of app.quadtree.queryRange(a.x, a.z, 400)) for (const fe of d.fireEscapes || []) { const dd = (fe.x - a.x) ** 2 + (fe.z - a.z) ** 2; if (fe.landings >= 4 && dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = fe; } } if (!best) return { none: true }; const th = (best.ry || 0) + best.facing, ox = Math.sin(th), oz = Math.cos(th); const pos = [best.x + ox * 9 + oz * 3, best.y + 1.5, best.z + oz * 9 - ox * 3]; const look = [best.x, best.y + best.h * 0.5, best.z]; app.teleportTo(pos[0], pos[2], 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos, look, fov: 60 }); return { fe: best, pos, look }; })()
